data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of $27.6m (2022: $34.4m favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $22.1 million for the 2021 underwriting year, derived from the gross claims development triangle. This contrasts with the narrative which states a net favourable movement (release) of $27.6 million in prior year claims. The narrative attributes this net release to a decrease in large catastrophe losses and positive adjustments to prior year claims across most lines of business, although it also notes lower reinsurance recoveries. Line of business movements, reported on a net basis, showed releases in Marine, Casualty, and Treaty lines, offset by strengthenings in Property.
raw_causal_phrases: decrease in large catastrophe losses compared to the previous year
positive adjustments to prior year claims across most lines of business
Reinsurance recoveries were however lower due to the absence of major catastrophe events.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $22.1m is a gross strengthening calculated from the 'Pure underwriting estimate - gross' claims development triangle on page 22, considering only the 2021 underwriting year as per instructions. This conflicts with the narrative on page 21, section 6, which states 'Favourable movements of $27.6m... net of expected reinsurance recoveries'. The LOB movements provided are also net of reinsurance. The causes listed are derived from the narrative describing the net claims ratio movement, which implies releases, creating a conflict with the gross strengthening identified from the triangle.
